name: The Estuary Suite
summary: A smaller room with its own terrace and estuary views.
description: The smaller of Ocean Exmouth's two hire spaces, the Estuary Suite shares the same building and the same estuary views but on a more intimate scale — a good fit for a wake, a christening tea, or a birthday for thirty or so. It opens onto the Ocean Deck terrace, so there is still outside space to use if the weather is kind.
